biggest_catch: The referred person must register through YOUR link and complete the account requirements ($500 in qualifying direct deposits within 90 days) — if they skip registration or miss the deposit threshold, you earn nothing.
catches: Referred person must register for the offer using YOUR shared referral link, open a new eligible M&T checking account, and complete all requirements.

For personal checking referrals, the friend must make at least $500 in QUALIFYING direct deposits (recurring payroll, pension, or Social Security) within 90 days — person-to-person transfers and bank transfers do not count.
Cap: $500 in referral rewards per calendar year; rewards do not roll over.
Referrer must be an active M&T Bank customer; M&T employees and California residents are excluded.
Reward is a $50 Visa Reward Card (not cash), delivered 4-6 weeks after all criteria are met, valid only 3 months after issuance.
Referred person must not have been a primary owner of any M&T checking account in the previous six months.
Rewards may be reportable as taxable income.

steps: Register for the M&T Refer Friends program as an active M&T Bank customer and get your personal referral link.
Share your referral link with friends or family (only the first referrer whose link the person uses earns the reward).
Your referred person must register for the offer through your link and open a new eligible M&T checking account.
For personal checking, the friend must complete at least $500 in qualifying direct deposits (payroll, pension, or Social Security — not P2P/bank transfers) within 90 days of account opening.
Receive a $50 Visa Reward Card for each qualifying referral, mailed to your registration address 4-6 weeks after all criteria are met (up to $500 per calendar year).
timing: Visa Reward Card delivered 4-6 weeks after all qualifying criteria are met.
